title: SecOps-NG Control Cross-Reference
description: Lightweight joining substrate that resolves a SecOps-NG stable control identifier (the shape used by `control_refs` in content/mappings/*) to upstream standard identifiers — OSCAL catalog control IDs and MITRE D3FEND defensive technique IDs — together with the offensive ATT&CK techniques each D3FEND tactic addresses. This schema is intentionally orthogonal to content-model/control.schema.json: that schema models the full OSCAL component-definition for a SecOps-NG control; this one is the thin cross-reference table that the NIS2 / DORA / CRA mapping YAMLs join against. CORE will populate the table for every control_ref used by the three regimes; EXTEND will add a linter that fails when a mapping references a control_ref with no entry here.

stable_id.description: SecOps-NG stable identifier for the control. Same shape as content-model/control.schema.json#stable_id so a future tool can resolve either schema from the same string.

title.description: Human-readable name of the control. Keep neutral, community-facing language; no vendor or operator branding.

summary.description: Optional one-paragraph description of the control intent. Mirrors `summary` in content-model/control.schema.json.

oscal_refs.description: Back-references into recognised control catalogs (NIST 800-53 Rev5, CIS Controls v8, ISO/IEC 27001 Annex A, etc.). At least one entry is required — a control with zero upstream catalog anchors is not yet cross-referenced.

catalog.description: Catalog identifier. Use the canonical short form: "NIST 800-53 rev5", "CIS Controls v8", "ISO/IEC 27001:2022", "NIS2 Article 21(2)", "DORA Article 5", "CRA Annex I".

title.description: Optional catalog title for the referenced control, copied verbatim for cross-walk readability.

d3fend_refs.description: MITRE D3FEND defensive technique anchors. At least one entry is required.

d3f_id.description: D3FEND technique ID, e.g. D3-IRA (Incident Response Analysis).

technique_name.description: Optional human-readable name copied from D3FEND for cross-walk readability.

url.description: Canonical D3FEND URL for the technique.

offensive_techniques_attack.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique IDs this D3FEND technique is designed to counter.

review_cadence.description: Optional declared re-assessment cadence for this control, expressed as an ISO-8601 duration (e.g. P1Y, P6M, P30D). Consumed by the F-CP-01 risk-analysis evidence stream and the F-CP-06 effectiveness-loop stream to decide when a control's most-recent attestation is overdue. Omit when the control is event-driven rather than cadence-driven.

provenance.description: Where these cross-references were captured from, and when. Provenance is required so consumers can re-check upstream drift.

captured_at.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) when these cross-references were captured.

notes.description: Optional free-form provenance notes. Community language only — no operator or contract references.
